description: src/client.rs:82-115 — six near-identical if-blocks each producing an InvalidArgument with the field name in the message. Idiomatic alternatives: (a) a const array of (name, accessor) and a fold, (b) helper macro `require_nonzero!(self.field)`, (c) keep as-is — the explicit form is most readable and the repetition is bounded. Filing as opinion-tagged because all three options are defensible. Note: locked crate.
